svg.title: D03 Rental step 3 · Renter: request form

g.text: Self-drive rental, step by step (renter, owner and administrator)

text.tspan: Prototype: SMS/email and the GCash gateway are not connected.
Rent a vehicle without a driver from verified ZamMove owners. Pickup and return within Zamboanga City. Each vehicle has its own refundable
2 days · only vehicles free on every one of those days are shown as available.
L300 Van · Small house or room moves, appliances, store deliveries
Plate ZAM ••07 · 3 seats · Manual · Diesel · owner Olga · deposit ₱6,000.00
Plate ZAM ••50 · 3 seats · Manual · Diesel · owner Olga · deposit ₱8,000.00
The owner reviews and approves your request. You can cancel while it is Pending or Approved.
Once approved, you and the owner sign a rental contract: in ZamMove, or on the printed copy at pickup. You can read it here at any time.
While you drive, you share your phone’s location from My rentals so the owner can see the vehicle. Tracking stops when the vehicle is returned.
Pay the full ₱13,000.00 (rental + ₱8,000.00 refundable deposit) before pickup. The vehicle is released only when both are verified.
At pickup and return the owner takes 6 photos (front, back, both sides, odometer, fuel gauge). Check and confirm them in My rentals: they protect you if
The deposit is refunded when the rental is completed, minus any damage claim you accept or ZamMove approves (the owner has 3 days after the return to
Your license must be valid until the return date. Bring it and the ID you upload.
Pickup and return are within Zamboanga City only. Check the plate, color and condition at pickup.
Rental ₱5,400.00 + deposit ₱5,000.00 · Verified paid ₱0.00 · ₱5,000.00 waiting for cashier ·
Read the contract and sign it here before pickup, or sign the printed copy the owner brings. The vehicle can only be released once it is signed.
Pay the full ₱10,400.00 before pickup. The first ₱5,000.00 goes to the deposit. GCash is simulated in this prototype; a cashier verifies each payment.
